xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex045042026-02-2416-13-44" status="finalized">2 pa 'thad <expan>pa'i</expan> <expan>phyogs</expan> ngos bzung ba ni ¦ de ltar <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">chen po rnams</rs> la bzhed pa mi 'dra ba 3 byung ba las 'thad ldan gyi bzhed pa 'di ¦ log par shes par khyad <lb n="12a6"/> med kyang || zhes pa'i <expan>tshig gi</expan> don la yang zhud shing ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">sngon gyi lo chen blo ldan shes rab</rs> swo kyang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3780"><expan>chos mchog</expan></rs> ltar bzhed pas <expan>de ni</expan> <expan>rigs</expan> pa <expan>yin no</expan> ¦ 'di ltar ¦ nor bu'i 'od la nor bur 'dzin <expan>pa'i</expan> blo de <expan>mngon sum</expan> tshad mar mi <expan>rigs</expan> te ¦ zhen yul la 'khrul <expan>pa'i</expan> rtog pa <expan>la sogs</expan> <expan>spyir ro</expan> ¦ <expan>rjes dpag</expan> tshad ma yang <expan>ma yin no</expan> ¦ <expan>rtags</expan> la mi rten pa'i <expan>phyi ro</expan> ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593"><expan>mkhas grub</expan></rs> ste ¦ nor <lb n="12a7"/> bu'i 'od nyid rgya yin zhing de <expan>rten no</expan> zhe na ¦ de'i tshe nor bu'i 'od <expan>rtags</expan> ya <expan>yin no</expan> ¦ de'i tshe nor bu'i 'od la 'od du ma nges par nor bu <expan>yin pas</expan> bzung <expan>ba'i ro</expan> || </seg></TEI>
